parsed.why: Statewide sex-at-birth order covers state facilities, shelters and custody; 2026 law bars gender-affirming care in public facilities for adults with criminal penalty; no state discrimination remedy. Most restrictive local layer atop the national document and border regime.

Criminal-trespass facility law reaches all government buildings including airports, with one documented arrest; DMV treats marker mismatch as fraud; no state discrimination protection; adult care restrictions only partly court-blocked.

No facility ban; enforced gender-identity discrimination protections with remedies; X markers on state IDs; city sanctuary order shields travellers' care access; sports bills vetoed or stalled. Well above the national line.

Low-risk tier for adults; governor vetoed bathroom and pronoun bills; protections via Title VII, executive order and nine city ordinances. But no state hate-crime coverage, panic defence stands, 2026 Pride collapse.

Worst-risk group; state stripped gender-identity protections and barred stronger local ones, leaving visitors no remedy; school-grounds birth-certificate restroom rule binds visitors; care ban under 18.
